study.selection_note: Compare signal production and execution under unchanged risk; prefer the smaller parameter adjustment. Freeze configuration before August replay. Prior baseline results were already seen, so this remains retrospective research.

final_replay_design.selection_rule: Retain original-parameter control and predeclared fast-confirmation sensitivity profile. No profitability optimizer or promotion to paper defaults. Phase metrics are derived from the fixed-configuration full replay.
final_replay_design.rerun_reason: Shared matching-engine limit-price correctness fix after August 27 halted. Parameters remain frozen.

limit_fill_failure.outcome: risk guard halted and flattened; original attempt did not produce a complete result
limit_fill_failure.root_cause: L1 one-tick slippage applied after limit matching could cross order.price()
limit_fill_failure.regression: Buy and sell limit-boundary cases failed; market and within-limit slippage controls passed.
limit_fill_failure.fix: Cap slippage at the existing order limit in shared apply_fills; retain market slippage and risk guard.
limit_fill_failure.artifact_note: Verified ZIP of generated replay input/events, original failure output and repaired output; raw history untouched.
